messages:
Maya: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need owners for the alert cleanup items (noise reduction, thresholds, dedupe, paging policy). I sketched owners below, confirm or reassign.

Maya: TL;DR: reduce noisy exporter pagers at night, tighten prediction-service mem thresholds, implement dedupe for identical errors across zones, and update paging policy for low-priority alerts.

Sanjay: I can own dedupe + duplicate-error suppression. Plan: add a fingerprint-based dedupe in alert-router and a rollout plan. Target: 2026-03-31.

Katie: I'll own threshold tuning for prediction-service and redis. Steps: run a 7d noise query, propose new thresholds, A/B test in staging, then roll to prod. Target: 2026-04-07.

Chris: I’ll take paging policy changes. Proposal: move non-critical alerts (severity: P2) to email-only overnight (00:00-06:00 UTC) and add a flap suppression window. Will draft policy today.

Maya: For dedupe, Sanjay, please include measurable verification: nightly pager count, unique alert keys, and mean time between page reductions. For thresholds, Katie add a diff to the alert-rules repo and tag the eval prompts.

Sanjay: ack. starting design now. sample dedupe config I'll iterate on:
```
matchers:
  - fields: ["error.message", "http.path"]
    fingerprint: sha1
window: 60m
```
I'll post the PR for review.

Katie: sample query for the 7d noise run (PromQL):
```
sum by(alertname) (increase(alerts_fired_total[7d]))
```
I'll attach the output to the PR for threshold recommendations.

Chris: draft suppression config (WIP):
```
suppress:
  hours: [0,1,2,3,4,5]
  severity: ["P2", "P3"]
```
Planning to fold into paging-policy v2.

ops-bot: Created ticket INFR-4526 and assigned to <@Sanjay>, <@Katie>, <@Chris>. Due dates: Sanjay 2026-03-31, Katie 2026-04-07, Chris 2026-03-29.

Maya: Let's add a recurring "alert quality review" every 2 weeks. First check-in: 2026-03-30 standup. If you can't make it, please ping here. :calendar: 

Katie: quick ask — can we get historical pager logs for the last 30 days? ops-bot can you attach or link the export?

ops-bot: Pager export uploaded: s3://redwood-ops/pager-exports/2026-03-01_2026-03-23.csv

Chris: small experiment idea: probabilistic dedupe — if identical alert repeats >3 times in 10m, suppress subsequent pages with a probabilistic backoff. Should reduce churn without hiding new failures. Will write experiment plan.

Maya: love that. Add the experiment plan to INFR-4526 and mark it A/B. We'll measure nightly pager delta and unique alert keys.

Sanjay: starting implementation today. Will post PR link + rollout checklist once ready.

Katie: running queries now, will post proposed thresholds and prod/staging comparison by end of week.

Maya: thanks everyone — I'll notify PM and CS that we have owners + timeline. I'll follow up after the first check-in. :+1:
